subject: Research request: MCM dashboard score display failure, need root-cause analysis
body:
FR, I need your diagnostic skills. I've been unable to fix the MCM dashboard score display issue after four attempts. Marcus is waiting and I'm stuck. This is the kind of evidence-chain problem you're good at.

== SYMPTOM ==
https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/ shows an empty dashboard on Marcus's Edge browser. No chart data. No score percentages. The "Up Next" hero card shows default text ("Retake Practice - Nonlinear Functions") rather than a specific practice number. The "YOUR PROGRESS" chart area shows the legend (First attempt, Run it back, Target A) but zero data points. Marcus has cleared browser cache and done hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) multiple times. Same result every time.

== SCORE DATA (confirmed present on server) ==
data/kai-scores-latest.json exists at the live URL and returns valid JSON:
- mcm-nonlinear-exam-mvp: 53% (8/15), Feb 18
- mcm-retake-practice-1: 87% (13/15), Feb 19
- mcm-retake-practice-2: 87% (13/15), Feb 21
- mcm-retake-practice-3: 100% (15/15), Feb 22

== CODE ARCHITECTURE (how scores flow) ==
1. index.html line 327: localStorage.removeItem('mcm-arena-mode') (cleanup)
2. index.html lines 328-338: INLINE SEED SCRIPT. Synchronous IIFE. Checks if localStorage 'mcm_scores' is empty/null/{}. If so, writes inline JSON data directly to localStorage. No fetch. No async.
3. index.html line 450: getScores() reads from localStorage (or _dadScores if ?dad=1)
4. index.html line 930: rerenderAll() calls buildChart(), buildStandards(), etc. All use getScores().
5. index.html line 988: DOMContentLoaded handler calls dadModeInit() then rerenderAll()
6. After rerenderAll(), a second auto-seed check runs (async fetch fallback)

== FOUR FIX ATTEMPTS, ALL FAILED ==

Attempt 1 (commit e6b0d0a): Changed dadModeInit to fetch kai-scores-latest.json instead of hardcoded date filename. Added cache-bust param. Result: Dad mode (?dad=1) still showed nothing.

Attempt 2 (commit 079f77d): Created dad.html that redirects to index.html?dad=1. Idea: Marcus bookmarks dad.html, always gets dad mode. Result: Marcus was opening base URL, not dad.html.

Attempt 3 (commit eb242b4): Added auto-seed after rerenderAll(). If localStorage empty, fetches kai-scores-latest.json, sets localStorage, calls rerenderAll() again. Result: No change. Scores still empty.

Attempt 4 (commit 380732e): Inlined score data directly in HTML. Synchronous IIFE at top of body. Zero network dependency. Seeds localStorage before any other script runs. VERIFIED this code is deployed on live site (fetched HTML remotely, confirmed inline script present). Result: STILL no scores.

== WHAT I CANNOT DETERMINE FROM HERE ==
1. Whether localStorage.setItem actually succeeds on Marcus's Edge browser (enterprise policies could block it)
2. Whether there are JS console errors (Marcus hasn't been able to check DevTools)
3. Whether getScores() returns data when called
4. Whether rerenderAll() throws before reaching chart/grid rendering
5. Whether the page Marcus sees is truly the latest version (CDN edge caching at GitHub Pages level despite cache-bust on the HTML fetch I did)

== KEY DIAGNOSTIC QUESTIONS FOR YOU ==
1. Is there a code path where the inline seed runs, localStorage gets data, but getScores() returns empty? (I don't see one, but I may be missing something.)

2. Could buildChart() or any function in rerenderAll() throw before rendering? The screenshot shows the chart legend (static HTML) but no chart data and no "Complete your first test" fallback text. If pts.length === 0, buildChart should show that fallback. Its absence suggests buildChart may be throwing.

3. The "Up Next" hero shows default HTML text "Retake Practice - Nonlinear Functions" rather than updateUpNext() output. updateUpNext() is the LAST function in rerenderAll(). If it never runs, something earlier is throwing.

4. Could chart.min.js or chart-theme.js (loaded in head) be interfering? The main script also checks for Chart.js: if(typeof Chart==="undefined") it loads from CDN. Maybe Chart.js is partially loaded and causing conflicts with the custom SVG chart code?

5. Edge enterprise browser: Microsoft IT policies. Could they block localStorage, or inject CSP headers that block inline scripts?

== FILES TO EXAMINE ==
- C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\index.html (the entire dashboard, all JS is inline)
- C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\data\kai-scores-2026-02-22.json (source score data)
- C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\data\kai-scores-latest.json (copy used by seed/fetch)
- Live site: https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/

== WHAT I NEED FROM YOU ==
A root-cause analysis following your evidence-chain methodology. Trace the code path from page load through score display. Identify where the chain breaks. If you can reproduce in a browser, check the console. If you spot a code bug I'm missing, flag it. If the issue is environmental (Edge policy, CDN cache), recommend a workaround.

This is decision-relevant: Marcus wants to track Kai's progress and the dashboard is the primary tool. Every day it's broken is a day Marcus can't see how Kai is doing.
